source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of infrared spectroscopy (PDF 192-193).

blocks.text: Covalent bonds springs jaisa rawaiya rakhte aur kai tareeqon se thartharate hain: khinchna (symmetric ya asymmetric) aur mudna. In thartharahaton ki frequencies spectrum ke infrared hisse mein hain. Jab organic molecule par aisi infrared tawanai daali jaye jo us ke kisi bond ki qudrati thartharahat ki frequency se mile, to woh kuch tawanai jazb karta aur thartharahat ka phailao barhta hai.

blocks.alt: Neele markazi atom aur do peele atoms ke teen khaake: symmetric stretching (dono bairooni atoms saath bahar), asymmetric stretching (aik bahar jab doosra andar) aur bending (zaviya khulta aur band hota).
blocks.caption: Bonds ki thartharahat ke tareeqe (Figure 29.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Har qism ki thartharahat ki apni frequency hai. Bilkul usi frequency ki infrared radiation jazb hoti hai, lekin sirf agar thartharahat molecule ka dipole moment badle.

blocks.text: Infrared (IR) spectroscopy compounds ko khaas frequencies ki IR jazb karne par thartharahat ki tabdeeliyon se pehchanti hai. Spectrophotometer sample se IR radiation guzar kar napta hai ke kitni jazb hui. IR tawanai sirf tab jazb hoti hai jab molecule ka dipole thartharahat ke saath badle, is liye O2 aur H2 jaise mutanasib, non-polar molecules IR inactive hain. O-H aur N-H jaise polar bonds zyada wavenumbers par jazb karte hain, aur chhote bonds aur multiple bonds (jaise ethyne ka triple bond) bhi, kyunke yeh bonds mazboot hain aur zyada tawanai chahte hain.

IR spectrum ke do hisse hain: 1500 cm^-1 se neeche fingerprint region aur 1500 cm^-1 se oopar functional group region. Yahan sirf functional group region use hota hai, jo organic compound ki qism pehchanne ke liye kaafi hai.

blocks.caption: Functional groups ki IR absorption hudood (kitab ka Table 29.2)

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Infrared spectroscopy kuch jadeed sarak kinare breathalysers mein use hoti hai: IR shua chamber mein saans se guzarti, ethanol ke khaas bonds pakre jate, aur saans mein jitna zyada ethanol, utni zyada IR jazb hoti hai. IR sensors motorways aur masroof shehri markazon mein gaariyon ke dhuen mein carbon monoxide, carbon dioxide aur na-jale hydrocarbons napne mein bhi use hote hain.

blocks.prompt: O2 aur N2 IR spectroscopy se kyun nahi pakre jate, jab ke CO2 pakri jati hai?
blocks.explanation: O2 aur N2 ka koi dipole nahi aur in ki wahid thartharahat (stretching) bhi dipole nahi banati, is liye yeh IR jazb nahi karte. CO2 ke bonds polar hain; is ki asymmetric stretch aur bending dipole badalti hain, is liye yeh IR jazb karti hai.

items: Bonds thartharate (stretch, bend); dipole badle to IR jazb.
Functional group region 1500 cm-1 se oopar; fingerprint neeche.
